project.title: When Corruption Becomes a Label: Diagnosing and Mitigating Class--Corruption Shortcuts in Model-Heterogeneous Federated Learning
project.target_venue: CCF-B/CCF-C machine-learning or federated-learning conference; ML-conference style

contract.gap: Existing corruption-robust HFL mainly treats corruption as nuisance variation; the manuscript studies client-specific class--corruption bindings that can turn operators into directional class cues and require target-aligned diagnosis.
contract.task: Define CLE-HFL, diagnose binding-directed shortcuts with paired DSA, attribute formation with matched HFL-versus-Local analysis, mitigate locally with taxonomy-assisted coarse-family PEW+BER, and test alternative explanations and boundaries.

questions.text: Does strong CLE induce a binding-specific directional shortcut?
Is the observed shortcut predominantly local-first rather than communication-first?
Can taxonomy-assisted coarse-family PEW+BER suppress CLE without private true corruption metadata?
Is BER benefit distinguishable from generic ERM, tail-risk, or shared-group robust objectives?
Does shortcut suppression replicate across controlled binding maps and another protocol-matched HFL communication base, and what utility boundary remains?
What do proxy non-identifiability, PEW error, and Oracle granularity audits imply about the limits of proxy-only certification and environment granularity?

contract.contribution: A four-part evidence chain: CLE-HFL formulation; paired DSA plus identification/proxy non-identifiability; local-versus-communication formation analysis; taxonomy-assisted PEW+BER with matched controls and boundary validation.
nonclaims: Not first federated spurious correlation work.
Not first environment inference, pseudo-group discovery, group reweighting, or counterfactual shortcut evaluation.
No operator-level PEW is proposed or implemented.
CDep is not part of the current pure PEW+BER method.
Source bootstrap is not training-seed uncertainty.
FedDF-fidelity does not establish uniform utility improvement or an official FedDF reproduction.
CVaR-DRO is protocol-matched and is not uniformly dominated per client.
JTT screen is not Formal evidence.
Smoke and benchmark accuracy are not scientific results.
Controlled CLE does not establish real-world deployment effectiveness.

semantic_locks.canonical: PEW is coarse family-level and taxonomy-assisted; operator-level metadata is not used by the deployable method.
DSA identifies a binding-direction operator-response contrast under explicit assumptions; it does not recover the full internal causal mechanism.
Source-clustered bootstrap quantifies evaluation-source uncertainty conditional on the trained checkpoint, not training-seed uncertainty.
FedDF-fidelity supports DSA suppression under a second protocol-matched communication base; utility gate fails and both arms are below the learning floor.
JTT is screen-only unless a future Formal comparison is authorized and completed.
CDep is disabled and absent from the current pure PEW+BER method.
